subject: alt-f
title: ALT.F.------RT.DY.
description: Chart 1 of 2 on book p. 107 (T(AF)M-11). ALT-F (alternative functionalism) is the subject, with the (C) prefix, "the concept of"; RT-DY (reality dynamics) is the partner, with the (C) prefix, "the concept of". From the subject: POL-ST (political state), POL-DYM (political dynamics), PHY-U-C (physical universe context) and PRI-INFO (principle information). From PHY-U-C: PROG-CONT (progressional continuance) and RT-OP (reality options). PER-TRS (perceived transition) is on a dotted line from PROG-CONT. From RT-OP: SOC-RT-DY (social reality dynamics). AFN (affinity negation) is on a dotted line from RT-OP.
